locationClosedCaptionsEnabled.description: Location-level closed captions are enabled or disabled.

locationTranscriptsEnabled.description: Location-level transcripts are enabled or disabled.

orgClosedCaptionsEnabled.description: Organization closed captions are enabled or disabled.

orgTranscriptsEnabled.description: Organization transcripts are enabled or disabled.

useOrgSettingsEnabled.description: If `useOrgSettingsEnabled` is `true`, organization-level settings will control the location's closed captions and transcripts. Otherwise, location-level settings are used.
